messages:
Maria S: FYI I'm seeing a bunch of fncall/structured-output rejects from the canary that weren't happening yesterday. ~18% of invocations are flagged schema_invalid in the last 30m.
Ajay K: hmm, any common pattern in the rejects? missing keys or bad types?
Maria S: Mostly missing 'status' and sometimes `metadata` is a stringified HTML blob. sample: `{"tool":"search", "result": {...}}` with no status/top-level envelope.
Kyler: that HTML blob sounds like downstream tool returning raw page and our adapter failed to coerce to the expected Shape. Is this a new model behavior or adapter regression?
Maria S: Canary started hitting a new tool-adapter image 2h ago (adapter-v2). Logs show occasional 502 from adapter-v2 then a passthrough string body.
Louise (sre): deploy-bot shows a canary rollout for adapter-v2 at 6:12 UTC, 20% traffic. deploy-bot: adapter-v2 deployed by @kyler at 06:10.
deploy-bot: [INFO] rollout started: adapter-v2 -> 20%
Ajay K: we should route rejects to fallback adapter-legacy instead of failing end-to-end. Current policy just increments quota reject and surfaces error to caller.
Kyler: agreed. Short-term: add routing policy that if fncall response fails schema validation, mark as recoverable and forward to legacy adapter (maintain idempotency). Long-term: tighten adapter contract + add unit tests.
Louise (sre): need telemetry first. Can we add `fncall.schema_reject_rate` and `fncall.recoverable_forwarded` metrics? Alerts if reject_rate > 5% for 5m.
Maria S: +1. Also want a small sampling endpoint in console to view raw response bodies (redacted) for user-reported rejects. Right now console only shows counts.
Ajay K: Console team pinged. console-bot: note added to product queue: 'fncall diagnostics: show 10 sampled payloads, redact secrets, show adapter version'.
Kyler: quick mitigation: I'm going to flip canary down to 0% for adapter-v2 and re-deploy adapter-v1. Will post changes.
Maria S: Thanks. Also we should avoid incrementing customer-facing quota on schema_reject when we can auto-forward. Right now quota usage spikes and customers see unexpected bill/friction.
Louise (sre): Good catch. Quotas team - consider a new quota-exemption flag `internal_retriable` for these forward scenarios.
Ajay K: For telemetry/alerts, let's include a histogram of sequence_length vs reject_rate — maybe long inputs correlate with the HTML fallback.
Kyler: action items: (1) rollback canary (I'll do now), (2) add metric + alert (Louise/Ajay), (3) console sample view ticket (console-bot created), (4) policy change to route recoverable rejects to legacy (Maria/Kyler).
Maria S: I'll assemble a quick postmortem draft with sample payloads and attach to the incident channel. Short notes: impact = increased schema rejects, customers saw 502s for tool invokes, internal quota counts inflated.
Louise (sre): If anyone notices persistent rejects after rollback, @louise will run a retention trace and open a P0.
Kyler: rollback complete, adapter-v1 back at 100% as of 06:45 UTC. deploy-bot: rollout reverted.
deploy-bot: [INFO] rollback complete: adapter-v2 -> 0%
Maria S: monitoring shows reject rate dropped to 1.2% in the last 10m. Thanks all.
Ajay K: follow-up: let's add an entry in the runbook for fncall schema rejects covering telemetry, console steps, and fallback routing config.
Maria S: +1, tagging #runbooks after I complete the draft. :thumbsup:
console-bot: ticket ENG-3451 created for 'fncall diagnostics UI' (priority: medium)
Louise (sre): closing loop: alert thresholds and quota-exemption plan approved by SRE. Will coordinate rollout with quotas team tomorrow.
Kyler: any objections to keeping the schema validation as a soft-fail by default (i.e., auto-forward to legacy) during canaries? this makes canaries less noisy.
Ajay K: fine by me if we also add a strict mode toggle for enterprise customers that want strict validation.
Maria S: fine. I'll include that config in the runbook. Done for now.
